name: Variant B: Functional Hero Summary

copy.headline: Your Relationship Compatibility Report
copy.oneLiner: A structured analysis of your connection across 5 key dimensions — attraction, communication, conflict, rhythm, and long-term potential.
copy.cta: Unlock Full Report — See Your Scores
dimensionDescriptions: How your elements and pace types create magnetic pull or distance.
How your communication styles align or clash in daily exchange.
Where friction naturally arises and how to navigate it.
The tempo of your relationship — fast, steady, or slow-burning.
Structural fit for building a shared future over time.
copy.currentWindowText: Current alignment: moderate. Key tension in communication dimension — see full report for actionable steps.
copy.shareCardText: We got our Compatibility Profile — 5 dimensions scored.

reasoning: Variant B frames the relationship reading as an analytical, outcome-oriented report. The headline is clear and descriptive, the one-liner lists the five dimensions explicitly, and the CTA emphasizes unlocking specific scores. This appeals to users who want practical insights and data-driven guidance. Pattern label is renamed to 'Compatibility Profile' to signal structure. Share card text focuses on the dimensional scoring, inviting curiosity without emotional overpromise. Upgrade strength is higher because the free preview clearly signals what the paid report contains — a full breakdown with scores.
